notes.title: Devlog #05 - June + Future Plans
notes.notes:
[p]Hi yall![/p][p]This update will be kinda similar to the last one, but this time I want to be a bit more transparent as to why the updates have been a bit brief.[/p][p]1: I've landed a new job, starting tomorrow as I write this. 
I've been working hard to make sure I’m ready for it, as I will be taking a 12 week long course, leaving me with not much free time.
I will however still be working on the game, if time allows me to. 

2: The majority of things I’ve been working on these past few months I kinda don’t want to, or can’t showcase. 
These are either spoiler related, just me bug fixing things, or currently too unfinished to show off. 
Currently, the cave section of the game has been quite a challenge to get perfected, you’ll know why when the game releases.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218777/df1b614df311e6af478f3c75091bb1aefa12964d.gif"][/img][/p][p]So I’ve decided to slow down these monthly updates for now, BUT! Not to worry, the game is still in development, I’ll just post things when I feel like I have something to showcase.[/p][p]What I think is important to note is that Wintertwined is a hobby project, and thus I will only work on it if I can and want to.
I still believe in this project, and there is no doubt in my mind that when it’ll be finished, it’ll be awesome![/p][p]For the near future the plans are as follows: [/p][p]-Make a proper game trailer 
-Finish the script 
-Work on a new puzzle 
-Keep yall posted[/p][p]Thanks again for reading this, I know it must be exhausting to see these updates flip flop between “Oh yeah, it’s all coming together” and “Oh, no it isn’t” all the time. But something something delayed games better Shigeru Miyamoto quote, you know. 

See yall next time! 
-Terry Scott[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #04: May Progress
notes.notes:
Hi yall,

This months update is a bit of a doozy,
I've been busy with a mayor home renovation, making it so that my PC had been stored aside for most of May.
I did finish this one animation of Winter ripping apart their sweater and covering up a wound. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218777/d45c0fcd210ec0b944c709449bdf1503d076761d.gif[/img]

I've also been drawing NPC's on my phone over the past few days as well. Some original, some based on friends, some a little bit wacky.

And I've been taking the time to write out bridges in-between scenes, thus far, the full scope of the story is nearly finalised.

If that sounds a bit weird, it's mostly cause I just kind of write as I go along, injecting overarching themes and symbolism whenever I see it fit. My workflow isn't very structured, but Wintertwined is a hobby for me, not a job, so I would rather work on it whenever I'm in the right headspace.

I'm slowly working my way towards the final act, I'm about 30% done with the set up right before it, I'm gonna be blunt about: I might be over ambitious with the plans for this entire section. This entire part of the game is gonna have some real memorable moments, let's keep it at that.

So for now, I'm gonna cut the update short here. I should have some extra free time in June, so hopefully I'll have something more interesting to share next time around.

Thanks for reading!
-Terry Scott

notes.title: Devlog #03: April Progress
notes.notes:
Hi yall!
Here's a small update on what I've been working on this past month.

I spent the majority of Dev time this april on drawing backgrounds, and I'm still not done with the current portion lol.
The section I'm currently working on is the "Mines" portion, a part of the game that is shaping up to be a really fun and creepy area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218777/4359fb0b7e1f518784670b522b53f798165ef9f7.png[/img]

This area is taking up a lot of time, mostly due to the environment being kinda hard to draw, but I'm having a blast with it.
I'm also implementing a new mechanic, currently called "Focussed Lighting"
It'll work something like this:
You can hold a button to focus your light in a certian direction, by shining the light into an enemies eyes, you can deter them from getting closer.
It's currently in the early stages of testing, but I'm already really happy with the result.
I won't show what kind of enemies you'll be using this on for now, but I can't wait to implement this further :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218777/43b0f4d28aa74944cb6b916a73c4e03012555b97.gif[/img]

To keep it light on spoilers and such, I will keep this post short this time around.
But I hope to have some more cool things to show off in the next post at the end of May :)
Thank you for reading, as always <3

-Terry Scott

notes.title: Devlog #02: March Update
notes.notes:
Hi yall, for this past month I've mostly been bug testing and retooling a certain part of the game: The LocalBuzz Flashback Scene.
As shown in the Demo, LocalBuzz as a company and location will be very important to the story of Wintertwined, though I won't tell to what extent yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218777/e5c18262f0147e03bb2fd369542ca10af5057465.png[/img]

I had already done a lot of work on this particular part of the game in 2023, though I had to change it quite a bit, because of the scene that was added to the demo.
The scene in the demo establishes a few things that were initially set up in this part of the game, but with this scene added, I could now focus on developing the story further.
I removed some elements, added a few and rewrote scenes to better fit the narrative. This part of the game has multiple important moments that will influence the ending.
This part can last anywhere from 3 minutes, to over half an hour, depending on how thorough you are and what kind of ending you’re aiming for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218777/d20dd2379a827d3f390f7c904a795b55f1fb676d.png[/img]

A small setback I faced with this part was a puzzle that had a weird bug. It’s a portion where Winter sneaks around a warehouse and has to avoid being spotted by the cameras.
Sometimes, at random, the cameras would detect Winter, even if they weren’t in view at all.
Luckily I managed to fix it, it just took 4 hours, yay game dev life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218777/1232c3a8d0be9699c9f27e7a034813f08c8179e5.png[/img]

As it stands, this part is 100% playable, but about 90% actually finished. I want to include more NPC’s to talk to and there’s no music for this section yet.
For now, I’ll set this part aside and focus on finishing the next part, which is the “Cave” segment.
This part will have a far, far darker atmosphere and is the part of the game where the horror ramps up dramatically, more on that in the next update (hopefully!)

Thank you for reading,
-Terry Scott

notes.title: Devlog #01: The Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hi yall!
Recently Wintertwined's development finally came out of hiatus,
Starting from now on,  I will be doing monthly Devlogs to keep yall updated on how the development is going.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218777/1992a0d84a1d9e8b02c7c392900ca83b7699498b.png[/img]

For this months update: The Demo Update!
A lot of elements from the first demo have changed pretty drastically, I figured the more up to date the demo, the better it would be if the demo reflected the current build of Wintertwined.
I have very little else to say about the demo, because you can play it, right now!

To all of you that have been interested in the development of Wintertwined:
Thank you, your support for this game means the world to me.

notes.title: Wintertwined - OUT OF HIATUS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218777/d973d6aec47a5eeea588cb117026d7b70b6134a2.png[/img]
For the past year and a half, the development of Wintertwined had been put on hold due to many personal issues.

I did take some time to smoothen out issues with the UI, graphics and the font, but that was all I could muster for a while.

However, starting from today onwards, I will be taking 1/2 days a week to fully focus on the development of Wintertwined, which means: Yes, Wintertwined is finally coming out of hiatus!

I cannot overstate how happy I am to finally be posting these words.

Back in 2023, I had reached what I had thought to be an 80% completion rate, but since then, the scope of the game has grown significantly. Most of the changes have been made to expand the story, add more depth to the characters and make the world more interactive.

Once again, I will not be making any promises when the game will be released, but I will be posting updates more frequently, hopefully monthly! I’ll also be updating the demo sometime soon and the Steam and Itch pages too. 

To those of you that stuck around, thank you from the bottom of my heart. I can’t wait to share my little game with the world.

-Terry Scott

notes.title: Wintertwined's Development is going on Hiatus
notes.notes:
On hiatus

Wintertwined will be going on hiatus until I find the time to actually work on it.

So, Yeah.
This isn't the update I've been hoping to post, but I haven't been able to get much of anything done since March.

To most, this won't come as a surprise. 
I've been far too ambitious with the project, especially as a first time, part time game developer.

I've switched jobs recently.
I have a lot to learn and work before I can comfortably pay the bills.
Currently I'm recovering from surgery, unable to sit behind a desk for hours.
As you might expect, this has impacted the development as well.

When will I pick up working on Wintertwined again?

I'm not sure.
If I'm lucky somewhere in July.
If not somewhere late August.

It all depends on a few things:

How quickly I recover from surgery
How much I earn from working full time
How much time I have in between

Thank you for your patience.

I promise the wait will be worth it.

-Terry Scott
